name: Torzu
description:
Torzu is an open-source Nintendo Switch emulator with targeted optimizations for modern x86_64 CPUs. Built to deliver fluid framerates, it enables playing Switch titles with high fidelity on PC hardware.

Features:
- Hardware-accelerated Vulkan and OpenGL graphics rendering pipelines
- Resolution scaling up to 4K and 8K with anisotropic texture filtering
- Broad support for modern game controllers with motion gyro aiming and rumble
- Local wireless multiplayer and network session emulation
- Optimized CPU instruction set builds (x86_64_v3) for modern processor architectures
